svg.text: #612 Enterprise Insurance Claims & Underwriting AI: 62% 18s STP Funnel & Fraud GraphRAG
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 1.2M Claims/Mo (40,000/Day) · Auto Part-Damage Seg + Policy Deductible Engine + 3-Hop Fraud Ring Graph
1. Three-Tier Insurance Claims STP Funnel (40K/Day)
Tier 1 (62% Low-Severity Claims <=$2.5K): 18-Second Straight-Through
• YOLOv11-Seg auto-part damage mask + MinerU medical/repair receipt OCR on 4× L40S
• Deterministic Policy Rules Engine computes deductible & sub-limits ($0.02/claim!)
Tier 2 (28% Complex Multi-Party / Commercial Claims): 72B VLM + NLI
• Qwen2.5-VL-72B maps multi-angle collision photos & CPT codes against policy riders
• Flags unbundled procedure codes & pre-existing rust/wear on 6× H200
Tier 3 (10% Organized Staged-Accident & SIU Fraud): 3-Hop GraphRAG
• Connects shared body shops, tow trucks, clinics & pHash duplicate damage photos
• Lifts SIU Fraud Ring Detection by +38.5% ($18.40M/year fraud leakage prevented!)
2. AI-Generated Fake Photo Defense & Fleet TCO
Defending Against Diffusion-Inpainted Fake Crash Photos
• Fraudsters use image diffusion to paint fake dents/scratches onto clean cars
• Pre-Gate runs EXIF C2PA cryptographic check + Error Level Analysis (ELA) +
100M-image perceptual hash (pHash) deduplication in 12ms before Tier-1 STP payout!
1.2M Claims/Month Insurer TCO Comparison
• Manual Adjusters + All-72B VLM Cloud API ($1.80/claim): $2,160,000/month
• Self-Hosted 3-Tier STP Fleet: 4× L40S ($3.8k) + 6× H200 ($20.4k) = $24,200/month
($0.020 / claim — 98.9% Compute Cost Reduction + $18.40M/yr Fraud Recovery!)
• Claim settlement cycle drops from 6.5 days to 18 seconds for 62% of policyholders
3. Actuarial Payout Invariant: Never Let an LLM Calculate Final Claim Payout Dollars!
• Use Vision/LLM strictly to extract structured damage parts, OEM labor hours, and ICD/CPT codes.
• Compute final payout = min(sub_limit, sum(approved_items) - deductible) × co_pay_ratio in a deterministic rules engine.
